note: Screening of the protected core against the dependencies this repository already has, in both of the languages it is written in. Reproduce with scripts/ip/build-dependency-corpus.mjs then build-offline-similarity-evidence.mjs.

supersedes.reason: The corpus was npm only. 151 of the 688 protected files are Python and it held exactly 1 .py file, so 22% of the protected core was reported clean against an effectively empty set. The finding is the screening tool's own: it came out of the run's numbers, not out of review.
supersedes.whatWasOverstated: Coverage, not the verdict. The 2 files it reported are still the only 2 non-Python files with findings, and both still measure zero characters of code.

corpus.pythonRootDiscovery: python3 reports sys.path, site.getsitepackages() and site.getusersitepackages(); every directory among them is linked.
corpus.declaredPythonDependencies: apps/tai/pyproject.toml declares fastapi>=0.115,<1. Its closure - fastapi, starlette, pydantic, pydantic_core, anyio, idna, typing_inspection, annotated_types, annotated_doc, typing_extensions - was installed to a target directory and passed through IP_CORPUS_PYTHON_ROOTS.
corpus.diskCost: none; hard links share inodes with the store and the interpreter

coverageByLanguage.detail: Comparison is cross-extension, and 1061 corpus files in .js/.ts/.mjs import react, call React.createElement or use a jsx runtime, including 57 React-family packages. The .tsx count understates what these 53 files were compared against.

The corpus contains no SQL at all, and SQL is not token-comparable to JavaScript or Python. These 24 migrations under apps/tai/tai/migrations were screened against nothing. This run says nothing about them.
26 stylesheets is too small a set to call a screening. Treat these 4 files as unscreened.

knownBlindSpot: Stage 3 is a negative result and is recorded as one. A wholesale identifier rename of a verbatim 1838-line copy defeats all three methods: normalisation replaces strings, numbers, comments and whitespace but not identifiers, and the winnowing fingerprint is computed over tokens that include them. A copy laundered that way would pass this screening. Anyone reading 'no findings' as 'nothing was copied' is reading more than the run measured.
establishes: No file among the 660 screened is copied from a package this repository depends on, and none is a comment-stripped or reformatted derivative of one.
doesNotEstablish: Anything about the 28 unscreened files; anything about a corpus outside our own dependencies; anything about a copy whose identifiers were renamed; and authorship of any kind, which is a separate claim with separate evidence.
